Kempinski Seychelles Resort 🌴 on Instagram: "We are delighted to announce that Kempinski Seychelles Resort Baie Lazare has retained EarthCheck Gold status, marking 7 consecutive years of certification for our commitment to sustainable practices!

This year, we unveiled the Seychelles’ largest hydroponic farm, featuring 8,000 cultivation pods that support 23 varieties of vegetables and herbs. The system is engineered to reduce water usage by up to 90% while completely eliminating chemical runoff – an important step forward in our journey toward regenerative operations.

In October, we also celebrated the opening of Les Petits Lazariens, our new eco-adventure garden. Thoughtfully integrated into the lush tropical landscape without cutting or relocating a single tree, the playground uses only plastic-free and toxin-free materials. Recycled components and natural elements ensure both safety and long-lasting durability, perfectly capturing our vision of sustainable luxury.

Besides, we have planted three Coco de Mer seeds at our resort that will grow into magnificent trees in 20-25 years, adding to the rich natural heritage of the Seychelles. The Coco de Mer is the largest and the heaviest seed in the world, weighing up to 25 kg. 

At Kempinski Seychelles Resort, sustainability is more than a responsibility. It is a defining part of who we are. Located in the heart of Baie Lazare, surrounded by rare biodiversity and vibrant local culture, we are deeply committed to preserving the natural beauty and heritage of Seychelles while offering exceptional hospitality. 

#KempinskiSeychelles #GHA #GreenCollection #EarthCheck #SustainableTourism"
